preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 500 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 0 and the maximum possible number of unique roads between n cities inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi, li in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 10**6 for xi, yi, li in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road has a length between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n * (n - 1) / 2 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ci <= m for ci in output)
postconditions.description: Each value in the output is between 0 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(cst == sum(1 for path in shortest_paths(s, t) for road in path if road in roads) for s in range(1, n) for t in range(s + 1, n + 1) for i, cst in enumerate(output) if i == (s - 1) * (n - s) + (t - s - 1))
postconditions.description: Each cst is the number of roads that lie on at least one shortest path from city s to city t.
